System: Free rescue vs Danger Line policy
Reproduction: Natural Game Over on a deep board (native seeds 93023/93033/93043, run 46178136922); press the free rescue button once
Expected: The free rescue clears the Danger Line and play resumes
Actual: Rescue failed: no safe clearing within the limit.; game stays GAME_OVER and rescue_remaining stays 1
Root cause: RescuePlanner treats every body above the Danger Line as a mandatory removal and returns {} when that set exceeds rescue_max_remove (10); a natural Game Over on a deep board always exceeds it
Fix: None in B.3: raising rescue_max_remove or changing the danger policy is a balance/design change and B.3 forbids it. Defect reported, not patched
